title: Organisation
description: A peace-building organisation referenced from one or more conflict pages.

id.description: URL-safe identifier used to link from conflict pages, e.g. "corrymeela-community".

country.description: Primary country or region the organisation operates in.

mission.description: Short, neutral description of the organisation's mission.

contact.description: Public-facing contact channel (contact page or email), not a fundraising link.

linkedInitiatives.description: Names of initiatives (from conflict pages) this organisation runs.
